whole_exchange_context:
Read all eight speeches as one courteous,animated gossip exchange. A6 asks whether A7 has heard that the princess is going to become engaged. A7 responds with the reported identity of the partner as the duke's son. A6 repeats an extravagant report that the engagement ring costs enough to buy a mountain. A7 treats that as characteristic of the duke,then wonders when they can see the princess wearing the jewel. A6 predicts that this will not be far off and that more women will want that gemstone afterward. A7 reacts with urgency:waiting until the fashion has caught on would be too late,and asks what the gemstone is and whether A6 knows. A6 admits she does not know and proposes going to ask right away. Preserve the comic contrast between elaborate gossip and their lack of the basic gemstone identity. The closing impersonal FE forecasts 宝石 becoming fashionable in ロンドン.
